title: feat(marketing): update homepage mock to show multi-thread-per-agent dashboard
body:
## Summary

Updates `DashboardMockup` on the marketing homepage to demonstrate multiple concurrent threads from the same agent, which is Threadzy's core value prop.

**Before:** 4 threads from 4 different agents (CFO, Ops, Sales, Research) — one thread each.

**After:** 5 threads total showing realistic multi-thread usage:
- 3 threads from **Research Agent** (AI Market Analysis, Patent Landscape Review, Pricing Model Research)
- 2 threads from **Ops Agent** (Vendor Contract Renewal, Infra Cost Optimization)

The main panel conversation also updated to show a Research Agent thread with competitive analysis content that reinforces the "desk not brain" positioning.

Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/5519f05a1f514136860c3ccb81cf1db6
